newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken says aims to move into Denmark.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken says aims to move into Denmark.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank S-E-Banken said on Tuesday it aimed to establish operations in Denmark within one year.
In a statement the bank also said it was studying investments in the Baltic region -- the Baltic States, Germany and Poland -- by opening branch offices.
"S-E-Banken's goal is to become the leading bank in the Nordic region," S-E-Banken said.
"Our ambition therefore is that the bank should continue to grow in Norway and Finland as well as establish itself in Denmark within one year," it said.
"Furthermore we are studying an investment in the Baltic region with several representative offices," it added.
The bank said it was carrying out some internal restructuring, saying it had decided to remove its divisional structure.
